extracted.intended_audience: interested parties and stakeholders in the Raleigh-Durham airspace change (pilots, airport operators, local residents, aviation community, commenters to FAA rulemaking)
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural and substantive guidance for participating in a virtual FAA fact-finding meeting and submitting comments on a proposed amendment to Class C airspace at Raleigh-Durham International Airport (KRDU). Covers registration, deadlines, acceptable topics, submission methods, and how comments will be recorded/used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comment deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments must be received on or before June 5, 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The document notes the comment period ends 06/05/2026 and references that comments submitted during the meeting and the associated comment period will be considered prior to issuance of any NPRM.

rubrics_metrics.name: Meeting date and time
rubrics_metrics.description: The meeting will be held virtually on May 6, 2026, from 5 p.m. to 7 p.m. (Eastern Time).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attendees should plan for the two-hour Zoom webinar; the meeting will be recorded and later available on the FAA YouTube channel.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration requirement for presenters
rubrics_metrics.description: To make a presentation at the meeting, you must register on or before May 5, 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You must indicate intent to present when registering so appropriate time limits can be established. Registration link (Zoom) provided in notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration for attendance (non-presenters)
rubrics_metrics.description: To attend the meeting without making a presentation, the public can register at any point prior to the start of the meeting within the space constraints.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Space is limited; attendance is on a space-available basis. There is no admission fee or other charge to attend.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of acceptable comments
rubrics_metrics.description: Only comments concerning the plan to amend the Raleigh-Durham International Airport Class C airspace area will be accepted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Speakers and written submissions should be limited to matters directly related to the proposed Class C airspace changes; off-topic remarks are not acceptable for this meeting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Speaking opportunities and time limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Each participant will be given an opportunity to deliver comments or make a presentation, although a time limit may be imposed to accommodate other speakers and closing times.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Time limits may be set to allow all speakers; indicate intent to speak at registration so FAA can establish appropriate time allocations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-registration ensures speaking order; adjournment policy
rubrics_metrics.description: This meeting will not be adjourned until everyone who pre-registered to speak has had an opportunity to address the panel. This meeting may be adjourned at any time if all persons who so desire have had an opportunity to speak.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pre-registering to speak secures a place in the queue; the FAA will aim to hear all pre-registered speakers before adjourning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission and deadline for position papers/handouts
rubrics_metrics.description: Position papers or other handout material relating to the substance of the meeting will be accepted and must be received on or before the June 5, 2026 comment deadline to be considered.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Participants submitting papers or handout materials should send them to the physical or email address noted in the ADDRESSES section (see submission methods).

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission methods and docket identification
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments may be sent to Andreese Davis at the FAA Operations Support Group physical address, via email to 9-AJO-RDU-Class-C-Comments@faa.gov, or submitted via Regulations.gov at https://www.regulations.gov/commenton/FAA-2013-0259-5318.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reference Docket ID FAA-2013-0259 when submitting to Regulations.gov; the notice includes both the mailing address and email for direct submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Meeting format and recording
rubrics_metrics.description: This informal airspace meeting will be conducted in a virtual format using the Zoom teleconferencing tool. The meeting will also be recorded and available to watch on the FAA YouTube channel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A representative from the FAA will present a briefing on the planned airspace prior to opening the meeting to public comments; the recording and a summary will be posted for transparency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public posting and docket summary
rubrics_metrics.description: All comments are considered public and will be posted online once the Transportation Department has reviewed them. A summary of the comments made at the meeting will be filed in the rulemaking docket.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions should not assume confidentiality; the summary and individual comments will become part of the public record in the rulemaking docket.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose and use of information gathered
rubrics_metrics.description: The purpose of the meeting is to provide relevant information about the proposal and solicit aeronautical comments of its effects on local aviation operations; information gathered will assist the FAA in considering the proposal and drafting an NPRM, if any.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comments received during the meeting and the comment period will be considered prior to issuance of any notice of proposed rulemaking; the public will have a separate opportunity to comment on any subsequent NPRM.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessibility and no-charge participation
rubrics_metrics.description: The meeting will be open to all persons on a space-available basis. There will be no admission fee or other charge to attend and participate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The meeting is informal and conducted by FAA representatives; attendees should register and follow the meeting procedures to participate.
